blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Three KPIs tell you almost everything about a logistics operation. On-time delivery is the percentage of shipments that arrive within the promised window. Cost per shipment is how much it costs, on average, to move one parcel. Damage rate is the percentage of parcels that arrive damaged.

Watch these three numbers every week and you will spot problems early. A drop in on-time delivery points to a bottleneck. A rising cost per shipment points to inefficiency. A rising damage rate points to a handling or packaging problem.

Three numbers, reviewed weekly, catch most trouble before it grows.

items.q: What does on-time delivery measure?
options: The percentage of shipments that arrive on time
items.why: "On-time delivery is the percentage of shipments that arrive within the promised window."

items.q: How often should you watch these three numbers?
items.why: "Watch these three numbers every week…" — o texto diz semanalmente.

items.q: A rising damage rate points to a problem with…
items.why: "A rising damage rate points to a handling or packaging problem."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a long report is better than three numbers
KPIs do not matter in logistics
watching a few key numbers helps you find problems early
cost per shipment is the only useful number
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende que três números, vistos toda semana, pegam a maioria dos problemas cedo.

items.q: "Catch most trouble before it grows" suggests that…
options: you should wait for problems to get bigger
small problems can become big if you ignore them
items.why: Inferência: ver cedo evita que um problema pequeno cresça.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry apresentar o novo painel para a equipe. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming. Today I want to show you something new.

For years, we sent a fifteen-page report every week. It was long, and honestly, nobody read it. So we are going to change that. From now on, we will look at just three numbers.

The first number is on-time delivery. This tells us how many parcels arrive on time. The second number is cost per shipment. This tells us how much we spend to move one parcel. The third number is damage rate. This tells us how many parcels arrive damaged.

That is all. Three numbers on one screen. You can read them in one minute.

Please look at the dashboard every Monday. If on-time delivery goes down, we have a bottleneck. If cost goes up, we are not working well. If damage goes up, we have a packaging problem.

Numbers are only useful if we act on them. So every week, we will look, and then we will fix. Any questions? Great. Let's get started.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why is Harry changing the old report?
options: It was long and nobody read it
items.why: "It was long, and honestly, nobody read it."

items.q: How many numbers will the new dashboard show?
items.why: "we will look at just three numbers."

items.q: When should the team look at the dashboard?
items.why: "Please look at the dashboard every Monday."

items.q: Why does Harry say "numbers are only useful if we act on them"?
options: Because the report should be longer
Because the team should not read numbers
Because looking is not enough — you must fix the problem
items.why: Inferência: ele quer que a equipe use os números para agir, não só olhar.

items.q: How does Harry seem to feel about the new dashboard?
options: Worried that it is too hard
Positive and confident that it is simpler
items.why: Inferência: ele apresenta o painel como mais fácil e rápido, com tom positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We check the damage rate every week." The damage rate is…
options: the percentage of parcels that arrive broken
items.why: Damage rate = taxa de avaria: quantos parcels chegam danificados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The trucks are stuck at the gate. That is a ___."
items.why: Bottleneck = gargalo: um ponto onde tudo trava.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Better ___ means fewer boxes arrive broken."
items.why: Packaging = embalagem: proteger bem o produto reduz avarias.

items.q: "Cost per shipment went up this month." This means…
options: each parcel is now more expensive to move
items.why: Cost per shipment = custo por envio: quanto custa mover um parcel.

items.q: "A KPI is a key number you watch." What does KPI help you do?
options: See how the operation is doing
items.why: KPI = indicador-chave: um número que mostra o desempenho da operação.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de operações. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Harry wants to roll out the new dashboard next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, começar a usar algo novo.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the plan today." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "On-time delivery went down. Let's look into it." To look into means to…
items.why: Look into = investigar, descobrir o motivo.

items.q: "Two workers pushed back on the new plan." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "We agreed to fix it, so let's follow through." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.
